entities.summary: Lima Zachariah Sopoaga is a professional rugby union player who plays as a fly-half for Japan Rugby League One club Shimizu Blue Sharks, and for Bunnings NPC club Waikato. Born in New Zealand, he represents Samoa at international level after qualifying on ancestry grounds.
